t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes usually come in pairs and will lead you to either a bright or dark forest. The main goal is to go to the forest where there are the most mushrooms. The number of mushrooms in each forest can change each time and focus should be given to the x5 rounds

vb_textbox.text: The most significant advice is to focus on the x5 rounds as they yield higher points/ mushrooms. The number of mushrooms tend to change with each forest but through my observation I found the best combination was pink, orange and red in the x5rounds.
